### 🟢 Approval recommended The guard change is a correct, narrowly-scoped fix with clear red/green test coverage and no caller regressions, with only minor out-of-diff comment staleness remaining. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR fixes a validation gap in `updateContextWindow` (the SDK/provider-driven self-correction path for model context windows). The previous guard used `typeof contextWindow !== 'number'`, which admitted `NaN` (since `typeof NaN === 'number'` and `NaN <= 0` is false) and `Infinity`. Such a value could then land in the active model rows and in `contextWindowOverrides` (top precedence, persisted via the cache), corrupting context-window accounting. The fix swaps the check for `Number.isFinite(contextWindow)`, so only finite positive values are accepted. **Changes:** - Replace `typeof contextWindow !== 'number'` with `!Number.isFinite(contextWindow)` in `updateContextWindow`, and refresh the adjacent persistence comment. - Add a test asserting `NaN`/`Infinity` are rejected, leave the rows byte-identical, and record no override. - Update the existing overlay-reload test so the `NaN` ratchet now asserts `false` instead of the old `true` behavior. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `packages/​server/​src/​models.js` | Tightens the `updateContextWindow` guard to `Number.isFinite` and updates the nearby learned-map persistence comment. | | `packages/​server/​tests/​models.test.js` | Adds a test that non-finite windows are rejected and no override is recorded. | | `packages/​server/​tests/​models-overlay-reload.test.js` | Flips the `#7771` NaN-ratchet assertion from `true` to `false` and refreshes its explanatory comment. | Advisory (outside the diff, not inline-commentable): two comments still describe the old guard hole in the present tense and are now inaccurate after this fix — `packages/server/src/models.js:468-470` (in `parseLearnedContextWindows`, "`updateContextWindow`'s OWN input guard admits NaN ...") and `packages/server/src/codex-app-server-session.js:1535-1537` ("`registry.updateContextWindow` tests `typeof === 'number' && > 0`, which NaN passes ... it would then write NaN"). Updating these in a follow-up would keep the documentation consistent with the shipped guard.
Review effort: Balanced
